 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The word **"Fortnitly"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is "Fortnightly," which means occurring once every two weeks or every fourteen days. (पखवाड़े में एक बार)

 
 
• **Example:** The magazine is published fortnightly, on the first and fifteenth of each month.
 
 
 
• The correct word is **"Fortnightly"**, which refers to something that happens every two weeks. (पखवाड़े में एक बार)
 
 
• **Example:** The team meets fortnightly to discuss project updates.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Frequently** (अक्सर): Occurring often or many times.

 
 
• **Example:** He frequently visits his grandparents on weekends.
 
 
 
• **Quarterly** (त्रैमासिक): Occurring once every three months or four times a year.
 
 
• **Example:** The company releases its financial statements quarterly.
 
 
 
• **Occasionally** (कभी-कभी): Happening from time to time; not frequently.
 
 
• **Example:** She occasionally goes hiking on weekends.
